versions.changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-gog-google-workflow-helper.

- Provides practical workflow, bug fixing, setup hardening, and reliability support for Gog-style tasks on Clawhub.
- Tailors outputs for local use: scripts, checklists, templates, and lightweight automations.
- Ensures clear validation, actionable results, and visible assumptions in every response.
- Triggers on keywords related to work-productivity, Gog, Google Workspace, and CLI automation needs.
- Demand and usability backed by multiple independent online signals (12 signals across 3 sources).
